data.name: Beclin-1 (BECN1)
data.description: Core autophagy protein required for autophagosome nucleation; regulated by mTOR and inhibited by Bcl-2 family members.
data.description_beginner: A core protein required to start building autophagosomes, the sacs that carry out cellular cleanup. It's controlled by mTOR and held back by the Bcl-2 family of proteins.

studies.title: Testosterone propionate maintains autophagic flux and mitochondrial integrity via regulation of the LC3B/p62/Beclin-1/mTOR axis in induced liver fibrosis.
studies.authors: Verma S, Vaishnav S, Yadav M, Verma A, Washimkar K

evidence.label: Animal model
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

studies.finding: Testosterone propionate protects against CCl4-induced liver fibrosis by maintaining mTOR-regulated autophagic flux via the LC3B/p62/Beclin-1 axis, preserving mitochondrial integrity; castration worsens fibrosis by impairing this pathway.

studies.title: Role of Autophagy in Scleral Remodeling During Form-Deprivation Myopia
studies.authors: Wen J; Tang S; Zhang Xiaoxiao

evidence.label: Animal model
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

studies.finding: Excess scleral autophagy links hypoxic stress to extracellular matrix remodelling in experimental myopia. In form-deprived guinea pigs, subconjunctival rapamycin made myopia worse and 3-MA alleviated it, while atropine slowed myopia and suppressed autophagy-related changes. AMPK/mTOR/P70S6K signalling was measured, but the paper does not establish it as the mediating route.

studies.title: Dioscorea polystachya Turcz. attenuates male reproductive aging through modulation of mTOR-Beclin-1-mediated autophagy in Leydig and Sertoli cells
studies.authors: Zhang Y; Feng J; Xie T; Zhang X; Pan D; Liu S; Zhao D; Wang S; Liu M; Yu S

evidence.label: Animal model
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

studies.model_system: Rat (aged model); Mouse Leydig (TM3) and Sertoli (TM4) cells
studies.finding: Chinese yam protein extract (CYCSE) attenuates male reproductive aging by activating testicular autophagy through the mTOR-Beclin-1 axis in Leydig and Sertoli cells; mTOR activation blocks protective effects.

studies.title: ULK1 induces autophagy by phosphorylating Beclin-1 and activating VPS34 lipid kinase
studies.authors: Russell RC; Tian Y; Yuan H; Park HW; Chang YY; Kim J; Kim H; Neufeld TP; Dillin A; Guan KL

evidence.label: Molecular — cells, biochemistry, structure
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

studies.model_system: Wild-type, ULK-deficient (ULK1-/- with ULK2 knockdown) and FIP200-/- MEFs; HEK293 and HeLa Beclin-1 knockdown-reconstitution lines; in vitro kinase assays with insect-cell ULK1/ULK2; C. elegans bec-1 S6A transgenic embryos
studies.finding: The authors asked how the ULK1 kinase switches on autophagy when amino acids are withdrawn. In mouse fibroblasts, amino-acid starvation raised the lipid-kinase activity of VPS34 complexes that contain ATG14L while lowering other VPS34 complexes, and the activation needed ULK kinase activity (lost in ULK-deficient and FIP200-null cells). ULK1 directly phosphorylated Beclin-1 at serine 14 (serine 15 in human), shown with purified kinase, mass spectrometry and a phospho-specific antibody; the mTOR inhibitor Torin1 or amino-acid withdrawal raised this phosphorylation only in cells with ULK activity. Cells reconstituted with non-phosphorylatable Beclin-1 S14A did not increase autophagosomes on amino-acid starvation, and the matching worm mutant (BEC-1 S6A) failed to fully rescue autophagic clearance in C. elegans embryos. The work provided evidence for a signalling chain from mTORC1 inhibition to ULK1, Beclin-1 and the ATG14L-VPS34 complex. Boundary: Mouse and human cell lines, in vitro kinase assays and C. elegans embryos; the mTOR step relies on Torin1 (which blocks mTORC1 and mTORC2) and amino-acid withdrawal. Not tested in mammalian tissues or in people.
